ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly asymmetric ratio; approximately 90-95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with 5-10% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels primarily localized in focal scars and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation across the entire fluke surface. Discrete, high-contrast white annular rings (approx. 10-20 pixels in diameter) are distributed non-uniformly across both lobes. High-intensity, high-density pixel clusters are located at the extreme lateral tips (0,y and max_x,y coordinates).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and a depth of roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the trailing edge, characterized by stochastic peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to acute, slightly upward-tapering lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive mapping of circular and semi-circular high-contrast white rings (rosettes) scattered across the ventral surface, most prominent on the mid-left and lower-right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks; notably a vertical mark on the inner left lobe and multiple short diagonal scratches on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity, irregular geometric structures (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; numerous circular depigmentation sites (rosettes) across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged protrusion on the right-most tip caused by a concentrated cluster of high-intensity, three-dimensional pixel structures.
